title: Q-TRAJ-drift-issues: issues are opening faster than they close: backlog grew by -10 over 30 days
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe drift:issues
**Status:** closed

issues are opening faster than they close: backlog grew by -10 over 30 days. Evidence: opened 929, closed 939.

Find what moved attention (or the backlog) and whether that was intended; if not, restore the balance in code.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe drift:issues` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T03:51:56Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
